data.name: Hiteshi
data.gender_notes: Hiteshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hiteshi is a Sanskrit female name derived from the term 'Hid' meaning sun and 'Eeshi' meaning goddess. It represents the city of God, where the goddess resides. The name is associated with power, wisdom, and divine grace. The name Hiteshi carries the meaning “City of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hiteshi usually hope their child will grow to embody city of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in divine femininity and celestial power.
data.etymology: Hiteshi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “City of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hiteshi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
